async def act(page):
    # Search for the thoughtbot/administrate project using the searchbox
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await searchbox.fill("thoughtbot/administrate")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)  # Wait for search results to load
    # Click on the project link; use case-insensitive substring match for robustness
    project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="thoughtbot", exact=False)
    await project_link.click()
